// @path: src/app/actions/somewhere.ts
// @expect: contains
// The sanitiser's NAME is not the sanitiser. `likeSafeQuery` is a variable that
// somebody called something reassuring; nothing has stripped anything.
//
// This fixture exists because a gate that looked for the marker with a substring
// test would wave it through, and that gate passed the rest of this corpus
// unchanged — which is the definition of a rule nothing was proving.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function searchSchools(likeSafeQuery: string) {
  return db.establishment.findMany({ where: { name: { contains: likeSafeQuery } } });
}
